trial_court: The III Addl. PRL. Judge, Family Court, Bangalore, MC No. 2229/2004
case_name: Smt Dr P V Lakshmidevi vs Sri Srihari S/O T.Ananthramaiah

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt Dr P V Lakshmidevi, wife

facts_of_case: Marriage between the parties was solemnized on 2-12-2004 and wife stayed in her parents' house after leaving husband. Petition was filed on 29-12-2004 seeking dissolution of marriage and decree of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party making allegations of cruelty to prove them.
legal_principles.held: On perusal of file, we find that the husband has made frivolous allegations that the marriage was not consummated due to irresponsible behaviour of wife's family members, and not due to irreconcilability of the wife.

legal_principles.principle: A party's vague and irresponsible allegations are not sufficient to justify a decree of divorce.
legal_principles.held: The husband has made vague and irresponsible allegations that his wife was guilty of cruelty, which is far fetched.

outcome.final_order: Decree of divorce dissolved by the trial court was set aside and marriage was dissolved.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for dissolution of marriage
